vb_textbox.text: HiThere are a couple things about this game you should pay attention to in this game.Gnome hat colour & Forest colour. There are 8 colours:red, orange, green, bluepink, brown, yellow, purpleIf you pick the 1st set of colours, you end up in the light forestif you pick the 2nd set of colours then you end up in the dark forest.From what I saw one of the forests give you more points when you end up there.I tried to visit the dark forest more oftenStay alert and get as many points as possible. The 5x multiplier is great!
